phase.description: Which phase this submission is for: draft = content draft for the user to confirm; arrange = final page plan for the builder.

title.description: Deck title; also the default file name for the builder.

narrative.description: One-sentence narrative spine of the deck (storyline, audience take-away; in arrange, also why the page order fits the audience).

title.description: Action title of the page (the conclusion, not a neutral label).

role.description: arrange only. Content role hint: cover | toc | section | content | data | table | flow | quote | closing.

density.description: arrange only. Information density tier: sparse = one big-line idea page (10 words is already too much); standard = normal 3-5 point page; dense = full-page data (chart/table/KPI, 200 words is not too much). The deck must alternate tiers for narrative rhythm.

points.description: Self-contained content points / evidence for this page; the builder sees no retrieval output, so every point must stand alone.

data.description: Real data this page must present: draft phase = plain sentences with real numbers; arrange phase = chart/table/KPI line format the builder translates directly.

materialHints.description: draft only. One sentence on what imagery this page needs (e.g. factory floor photo, growth curve); arrange uses it to search the material library.

url.description: Direct http(s) image link, or an everroom-material:// reference returned by material_search; the engine rejects anything else.

desc.description: What the image shows and where it fits.

materials.description: arrange only. Material image links for this page; omit entirely when none were found.

notes.description: Directional emphasis/layout suggestions for the builder (no pixel-level commands).

pages.description: Per-page plan in page order; first item is the cover.

warnings.description: Research gaps and material shortages worth passing through.

summary.description: Concise description of this phase's result: storyline, page count, material situation.
